cue: A check passes in a test world laid out differently from the real one.
lesson: Run every new check once on the real layout, and plant one failure there; a check that never fails may check nothing.
evidence: brain check matched no commit for hours: theOS is a subfolder and its git path filters read theOS/theOS; the tests built flat repositories; called green twice (aip-836d, checkpoint 3 review, fixed at 326f9d048).
